title: HealthResponse
description: Body of GET /api/health. HTTP 200 when status is ok, 503 when degraded.

database.description: "ok", or what is wrong with the database and how to fix it.

storage.description: "ok", or what is wrong with file storage and how to fix it.

commit.description: The git commit the API was deployed from (CLEARFEA_COMMIT), or "development" when it runs locally. The deploy checks it to know the new version is live.
